client_summary: SEOpie scanned 1 page(s) and found 1 high-priority SEO issue(s). Address indexability, metadata, broken links, and technical signals first because those items can directly affect search visibility and user trust.

issues.title: Title tag is very short
issues.description: Very short titles often miss useful keyword, service, or brand context.
issues.recommendation: Expand the title with clearer topic or brand context.

issues.title: Missing meta description
issues.description: A missing description gives search engines less control over the snippet shown to users.
issues.recommendation: Add a plain-language meta description that summarizes the page value.

issues.title: Missing canonical tag
issues.description: Canonical tags help clarify the preferred URL when duplicate or similar pages exist.
issues.recommendation: Add a canonical URL to reduce duplicate-content ambiguity.

issues.title: Page has thin body content
issues.description: The page may not contain enough useful body copy for its target intent.
issues.recommendation: Add useful, specific content that answers the searcher's intent.

issues.title: No internal links found
issues.description: Internal links help crawlers discover related pages and help users move toward conversion paths.
issues.recommendation: Add relevant internal links to related pages or conversion paths.
issues.evidence: The page does not link to another same-site URL.

issues.title: No structured data detected
issues.description: Structured data can help describe the page entity, service, article, product, or organization.
issues.recommendation: Add relevant structured data when it helps describe the entity, service, article, or product.
issues.evidence: No JSON-LD or microdata blocks were found.
